activity.notes: Akaitcho was the paramount leader of the Yellowknives (Copper Indians) encountered by John Franklin's expedition in 1820 and remained a major Yellowknives leader until his death in 1838. ATLAS uses Yellowknives Dene as his own political community rather than Canada or a colonial authority.

sources.title: Arctic Profiles — Akaitcho (ca. 1786–1838)
sources.citation_text: The scholarly profile identifies Akaitcho as the paramount leader of the Yellowknives in 1820 and describes his band and role in Franklin's expedition.
